dex.entry: The Tide Constellation Warden — a vast, semi-transparent sea-spirit that dwells in the Tideglass Cavern landmark. art.silhouette: Enormous translucent whale-like form, body almost entirely composed of moon-on-water refraction — shifting aqua, silver, and pale gold layers visible within. No hard edges, no single colour — a living sea-mirror. Two vast luminous crescent eyes and trailing aurora-thread fins.
